pages.text: $(bold)Provides$(): $(#ad03fc)Spawns small versions of itself to fight for you.$()$(br)

pages.title: Ritual
pages.text: The $(#ad03fc)Shub Niggurath$() is not summoned directly. First, summon a $(l:familiar_rituals/familiar_chimera)Chimera Familiar$(/l) and feed it a $(item)golden apple$() to detach the $(#ad03fc)Goat$(). Bring the goat to a $(#ad03fc)Forest Biome$(). Then use $(item)any Black Dye$(), $(item)flint$(), and $(item)ender eye$() on the goat. The fixed upstream code accepts $()

pages.title: Description
pages.text: $(bold)Upgrade Behaviour$()$(br)When upgraded by a blacksmith familiar, it gets a warning bell. When the familiar is hit, it rings the bell and $(bold)attracts enemies$() in a large radius.$(br)
